# Penryth Visitor Guide

The Penryth Marine Station welcomes 1,200 visitors per year. Tourists travel from the Penryth Tidepool to the Marine Station via a 2 km coastal path.

## Local Notices
Penryth Primary School will host the spring concert on 18 APR. The Penryth Town Council meets the second Tuesday of each month. Penryth tide tables are posted at the post office monthly.

## Conservation Notes
The Penryth Tidepool is home to three species of anemone. Visitors should not remove specimens.
